visual_sampling: Every second node on each array axis: indices 0,2,...,62, 32^3 nodes. No interpolation before export. Isosurfaces use piecewise linear marching tetrahedra.
encoding: Per-field affine unsigned 16-bit quantisation. Maximum absolute quantisation error <= scale/2. Little endian base64, decoded in browser.
diagnostics: Computed here from stored component-standardised arrays, not historical evaluation results. numpy.gradient on 64^3 with spacing 1 array index and first-order boundaries; omega=curl(v); Q=0.5*(Omega:Omega-S:S), S=(G+G^T)/2, Omega=(G-G^T)/2. No dimensional physical interpretation or y+ location is asserted. Derivatives are sampled after calculation.
q_source_difference: src/physics/q_criterion.py multiplies the full symmetric contraction by an extra factor 2. The viewer explicitly uses conventional Frobenius contractions; it does not silently reproduce that source variant.
spectra: Full 64^3 fields, per-component spatial mean removed. Shell sum of 0.5 sum_c |FFT(v_c)|^2 / 64^6 in nearest-integer radial mode bins. Sum over all bins equals 0.5 mean sum_c fluctuation^2 (Parseval). Plot bins 1..32; energies beyond32 are retained in exports. No inertial-range fit. Patch-periodic/index-space diagnostic, not physical channel spectrum.
runtime: Read-only, lightweight saved-array postprocessing. No checkpoints loaded; no neural inference, training or remote jobs.
